rationale: Point-in-time recovery (PITR) keeps continuous backups of a DynamoDB table for the last 35 days and is the only mechanism able to restore the table to a specific second. Without it, the table can only be restored from whichever on-demand backups happen to exist, so an accidental deletion, a faulty write or a compromised application can lead to permanent data loss.
remediation: Enable point-in-time recovery on the table
